steps.content: When you open your eyes again, you hear some familiar voices.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, are you alright? Are you hurt?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Sob, Chief, we finally found you! You seem even thinner than before... Chief, I've really missed you. I always complained about the endless tasks you assigned, but things just weren't the same without you...

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: I'm glad you're alright, Chief! Now that you're back safely, we can finally get some good sleep... Tracking Sinners is one thing, but tracking you is way scarier...
The adjutant looks slightly hesitant and apologetic as she takes your hand, nodding solemnly at you.
The sunlight shines on you, and for some reason, you find it a bit glaring. It seems you've become too used to the dark in just a few days, after all, no sunlight ever seeps into her house.
You don't want to give up on her; you want to look for her. But before that...

options: The attack case isn't over yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We thought we understood the dark web, but we were wrong... There are still more people lurking behind the scenes...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know their target. Go after them. Hurry, it's not over yet...
